about: Detection only: this language has no parsing tables yet, so a recipe detected as Spanish is shown as written. detect: case-insensitive regex fragments matched as whole words in the recipe's name and ingredient lines; the language with the most hits wins when it has at least 3 and more than twice the runner-up's, and then it also overrides a page that declares another language (owner's decision on #14). Only words distinctive against the other detected languages: no 'de', 'sal', 'picado', 'e'.
